messages:
ops-bot: [ALERT] 2026-03-23T10:29:37Z — Detected elevated 503s from eu-west-1 kv-cache tier impacting hosted text-generation paths that rely on prefix cache. Auto-fallback to uncached execution enabled. Incident tracking: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/1717777777 :rotating_light:

Mira (oncall): I'm looking. Dashboards show kv-cache write I/O saturation + increased eviction retries. Beginning rolling restart of the affected cache pool (a3 nodes) to force clean state.

Emil (eng-sre): Seeing kernel OOM markers and slab alloc failures on several pods. Attaching recent log snippet:
```
[2026-03-23T10:27:12Z] kv_cache: eviction failed: slab_alloc_retry
[2026-03-23T10:27:15Z] mem_cgroup: reconstrain -> reclaim triggered
```

Sophia (support): Support is drafting a customer message for those on "high-cache" routing. I'll post to #support-updates and DM top customers. No billing impact expected; primarily latency regression.

Leo (product): Are Dedicated deployments affected? We should avoid any confusion in customer comms.

Mira (oncall): Dedicated pools unaffected — issue is limited to multi-tenant hosted kv-cache in eu-west-1. Fallback path keeps requests succeeding, but tail latency is up ~200-300ms for cached prefixes.

Arjun (infra): Spinning up additional read replicas and increasing cache eviction headroom by adjusting slab limits. Scaling change initiated — ETA ~6m.

Sophia (support): Customer note draft: "We've detected elevated errors in our eu-west hosted cache causing increased latency for some requests. We've enabled a fallback path and are actively scaling the cache. No data loss expected; we'll continue to update." Will post after you validate, Mira.

Mira (oncall): That looks good. Emil + Arjun, please capture node images and heap snapshots for RCA. I'll keep monitoring.

ops-bot: Update 10:35Z — additional replicas provisioned, error rate trending down. Link: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abc/kv-cache?orgId=1

Emil (eng-sre): Error rate has dropped from 6.1% -> 0.9%. Still seeing occasional eviction spikes; keeping mitigation in place.

Sophia (support): Status page updated and sales ops alerted. Template note posted to #support-updates.

Mira (oncall): Next update in 15 minutes or when error rate <0.1% for sustained 10m. Postmortem owners: Emil, Arjun.

Leo (product): Thanks team — I'll prepare a short customer-facing summary once we confirm stable.

Arjun (infra): Snapshot and logs saved to s3://redwood-incident-artifacts/1717777777/

Mira (oncall): Current status: mitigation active, fallbacks in place, no data loss, customers notified. Closing criteria: sustained error rate <0.1% and tail latency back to baseline for 10 minutes.

ops-bot: Will auto-post final update when criteria met. :white_check_mark:
